I highly recommend Babel for the great writing that blends suspense and dark humor.
Stellar performances and a thought-provoking script make Babel a story of the moment.
What draws you into Redtwist’s Babel (directed by Rinska Carrasco-Prestinary) is the uncanny nature of the unfolding scenes.
Unfortunately, the execution is less compelling than the premise.
In its current state, the play is still highly recommended.
Considering all the rationalizations and explanations that went into setting up this dystopia, I wanted to like the play more than I did.

cn.t: This dystopian drama about engineered procreation offers a solid, relevant premise but struggles in execution, earning mixed-to-negative reviews for its well-intentioned yet flawed exploration of a futuristic society.
